A carpenter from Bristol, England, who came on the Mayflower in 1620 with his first wife and infant son,
and signed the Mayflower Compact. His third wife, Christian Penn, came on the Anne in 1623;
their son Benjamin was born at Plymouth in 1628.
Francis died before November 1633. She came to Plymouth on the Anne in 1623 and became the third wife of Francis Eaton,
the Mayflower carpenter. After his death in 1633 she married Francis Billington,
who had come on the Mayflower as a boy.
